name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: No unexplained disease clusters under international investigation
state: WHO's current emergency reporting concerns known pathogens, chiefly Bundibugyo Ebola (WHO). UK outbreak surveillance lists no novel pathogen (NaTHNaC), and searches on 7 Nov found no unexplained cluster under international investigation.
for_you: No action needed; check NaTHNaC before travel.

why: The next pandemic will start as an unexplained cluster; early signals matter.
drivers: Surveillance reports, unknown illnesses, new pathogens.
